name: Tahitótfalu (Hungary)
description: Blue field with a serrated border of red triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tahitótfalu (a yellow shield with a white castle within a yellow frame) above the name Tahitótfalu in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tahitótfalu arms in a yellow frame
